support.title: Support
support.lead: Use the channels below to report a problem, ask a question or send a suggestion.
support.issuesBody: Open an issue in the app's source repository. For a bug, add the details listed below.
support.contactBody: You can reach the developer through the contact page on their own site.
support.reportScreenshot: A screenshot, if you have one
support.reportPrivacy: GitHub issues are public. Do not attach vault files or personal content.
support.faqVaultA: The vault is a folder of plain Markdown files. You choose the folder or use Kenet's own folder; if iCloud is available, the vault can also live in iCloud.
support.faqObsidianQ: Can I open it with Obsidian?
support.faqObsidianA: The vault uses the same format as Obsidian. Kenet opens an existing vault in place, so you do not have to move any files. On Mac, Obsidian can stay as a backup editor.
support.faqBackupQ: How do I move or back up my data?
support.faqBackupA: The vault is a folder, so copying the folder is enough. There is no export step; the files are plain Markdown and open in any text editor.
support.faqIcloudA: No. Storing the vault in iCloud is optional. You can use a local vault or open a folder you pick yourself.
